title: Patient Payment Plan Installment Recompute After Added Balances: Account Action Reference
content:
**Rule.** When balances have been added to a signed **Patient Payment Plan** (active or past due) since its installment was last figured, the installment is recomputed over the remaining schedule; an offer not yet signed is never recomputed under this rule. When balances are added to a signed plan, its installment is recomputed under this rule over the remaining schedule this rule figures and never below the floor this rule gives; an offer not yet signed is instead re-figured on the balance it carries.

**When the recomputed installment is fixed.** The recomputed installment is fixed only after the installments that an open financial assistance application of the patient holds back have been paused and moved to the end of the schedule. The recomputed installment is not fixed until a plan that has fallen past due stands active again with no missed installment recorded.

## Booking the recomputed installment

**Capability.** The plan's regular monthly installment is replaced by the amount given; the plan balance, the number of scheduled installments, the status and the due dates are left as they are. The plan then shows the new installment amount.

**How it is invoked.** `recompute_plan_installment_b9083db3` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | the reference number of the patient's payment plan, as returned by the payment plan lookup for this patient | plan reference number |
| `monthly_payment_usd` | the recomputed regular monthly installment | USD with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded by the caller; a plain number without a currency sign |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Installment on plan <plan reference> recomputed to <amount> USD." Receiving it means the recomputed installment was booked.
